Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Master Student AI Powered Compliance Assistant (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an AI Powered Compliance Assistant with RAG Application (d/m/w)?

Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Operational PRC as a Master student (d/f/m)!

Location: Friedrichshafen
Start: 01.08.2026
Duration: 6 months

Your location
At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

- Independent working style and problem-solving mindset

jobs.occupation: PhD Measuring and Scaling Agentic Software Engineering (f/m/x) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 195022

Our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad have made us one of the world's leading premium manufacturer of cars and motorcycles as well as provider of premium financial and mobility services.

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE CREATE WHEN WE TAKE OUR VISIONS TO THE LIMITS.

PHD AT THE BMW GROUP.

Bridging the gap between your doctoral studies and the kind of career challenge you’re looking for isn’t always easy. That’s why our ProMotion PhD programme gives you the opportunity to apply your passion and scientific expertise to very real challenges that could shape the future of mobility. If selected, you’ll have the chance to really develop your own future career path with us through your practice-related thesis, promote your chosen specialty from within – and position yourself to secure the career you’ve always wanted.

Our New Technologies team explores and evaluates emerging technologies and brings the most promising ones into productive use across the BMW Group. Agentic software engineering is one of these technologies, and as a PhD candidate, you help find ways to systematically measure agentic software development and scale it to real-world use.

What awaits you?

- You design benchmarks that evaluate coding agents on real automotive codebases across the full development lifecycle.
- Within this project, you investigate where agents lose relevant code between exploration and generation - a failure mode that grows with codebase size and remains unmeasured.
- Building on these insights, you explore methods that help agents preserve and use relevant code more effectively.
- In this role, you help develop verification and testing approaches that keep agent-generated code trustworthy without slowing down development.
- Together with the team, you benchmark agent configurations, LLMs, harnesses and scaffolding across heterogeneous stacks such as embedded C/C++, Java, Python and Go.
- Finally, you translate your findings into research and deployment frameworks that can be applied at real-world scale.

What should you bring along?

- Studies in computer science, data science, mathematics or a comparable field.
- Solid knowledge of machine learning, in particular large language models and agentic systems.
- Strong programming skills in Python; experience with C/C++, Java or Go is an advantage.
- Hands-on experience with agent evaluation and benchmarking, for example SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, tau-bench or comparable frameworks.
- Ideally first publications or submissions at relevant scientific venues during your studies.
- Very good English language skills; German is an advantage.

Are you excited about advancing the science and practice of agentic software engineering at automotive scale? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online through our career portal. Applications submitted via other channels (including email) cannot be considered. Citizens of countries outside the European Union must have a valid residence or work permit for the duration of the program.

If you make it to the next round, you will receive an invitation to a video interview by e-mail. Please also check your spam folder regularly.

What do we offer?

- Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding.
- Personal & professional development.
- Flexible working hours.
- Digital offers & mobile working.
- Attractive & fair remuneration.
- Annual special payments such as vacation pay and Christmas bonus.
- Apartment offers for students (subject to availability & only Munich).
- And many other benefits –see bmw.jobs/benefits

Start date: 02.11.2026

Duration: 36 months

Working hours: Part-time

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about shaping the future of biologics development and driving scientific excellence in analytical and microbiological safety strategies? Join Boehringer Ingelheim's CMC Development Biologicals organization and play a key leadership role within the Quality Control team, where you will influence strategic decisions, engage with regulatory authorities and scientific communities, and advance innovative solutions across our development pipeline. Leading a team of highly ambitious experts, you will help strengthen our microbiological and viral safety capabilities while delivering scientific and regulatory excellence for patients worldwide.
Ready to make a meaningful impact and shape the future of biological medicines? We look forward to receiving your application.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
This position has a hybrid setup with a minimum of 3 days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead your team by providing clear directions, prioritizing tasks and developing strategies.
- Furthermore, you will contribute to the Quality Control Leadership Team by making continuous improvements, strengthening the team's impact across the development value chain, and leading project-related initiatives.
- You will also Initiate and lead innovation projects by identifying strategic needs in the organization
- In addition, you will develop and maintain solid microbial and virus-safety strategies.
- You will actively contribute and influence the scientific and regulatory community by representing Boehringer Ingelheim at conferences and in industry consortia
- Finally, you will shape the microbiology network within Boehringer Ingelheim and ensure seamless interfaces.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in Virology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Biology or Biochemistry, or a related quantitative scientific discipline
- Strong scientific expertise in microbiology and virology, with a proven ability to apply knowledge in a research and development environment
- In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices related to microbiology and virology
- Solid knowledge of Novel Biological Entity (NBE) development principles, processes, and associated requirements
- Passion for innovation and emerging technologies, particularly in the detection, characterization, and monitoring of viruses and microorganisms
- Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities
- Demonstrated leadership experience is a plus
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, supported by a strong professional network

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Job description

In order to support our team “Supp. Engineering Trsp./Miss. GE”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).

The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. This is achieved by integrating diagnostic functions, sensors and standardized interfaces to ensure that fault identification, isolation and verification are performed with maximum speed, precision and cost-efficiency. The overall target is minimizing MTTR and diagnostic costs.

ABAP Developer (m/f/d) Limited Contract (1 year)

Date: 08/31/2026

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Note: Contract duration - from 01.01.2027 until 31.12.2027

Role Summary & Information:

You'll join a team developing the future of enterprise data transformation. Design and build production-grade, high-volume data processing applications that move billions of records with precision and speed. This role puts you at the intersection of scalability challenges and elegant solutions—where every optimization matters and performance isn't just a feature, it's the foundation.

Beyond building, you'll ensure system reliability. When production issues surface, you'll conduct incident analysis and design stability improvements that strengthen our platform. You'll own the problems that matter to the world's largest enterprises.

What You'll Bring:

You have strong software development and analytical skills and hands-on experience building and operating cloud-based business solutions.

Further requirements are:

- 
Take responsibility for end-to-end quality – from development and testing through production support. You drive solutions!

- 
Eagerness to learn and explore new topics.

- 
Ability to work independently.

- 
Goal-oriented team player with good communication skills.

- 
A solid understanding cloud-based software development and CI/CD practices.

- 
Profound development skills in ABAP OO or another objected-oriented programming language

- 
Experience with AI supported development.

- 
Excellent communication skills in English or German language

Meet Your Team:

You will work on development topics end-to-end while collaborating closely with your colleagues in an agile Scrum team. We value direct communication, shared accountability, and continuous improvement. You will participate in code reviews, share technical knowledge, and help build team capabilities—all while deepening your expertise in ABAP, AI-supported software development, and agentic engineering.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
